title: Plasticity coupling + element deletion at D > D_crit
objective: Integrate Lemaitre damage into the codegen: extend the plastic history field to store (alpha, D), emit the coupled return map in the Taichi kernel, and add element-deletion logic when D exceeds D_crit.

plan_assets.asset_description: B6.1 element deletion at D > D_crit.

scope: Extend `solver/history_fields.py` so `material_type='lemaitre'` allocates (alpha, D) per qp.
Extend `emit_internal_force_kernel` and `emit_tangent_matvec_kernel` for the Lemaitre branch (reuse the analytical-tangent path via radial_return).
Add an `is_deleted` boolean field per element; when D > D_crit at any QP, set it and skip the element in assembly.
Deleted elements contribute nothing to force or tangent.
implementation_steps: Branch `compute_internal_force` on material model: Lemaitre path calls `lemaitre.radial_return` and writes back both alpha and D.
Add the `is_deleted` field and the skip-if-deleted guard in the element loop.
Unit-test element deletion: initialize D at 0.95 for one element, run one step with damage evolution, assert the element is marked deleted.
acceptance_criteria: Emitted Lemaitre code compiles as valid Python.
Element deletion works: an element with D > D_crit contributes zero force.
At D = 0 everywhere, the emitted Lemaitre code produces the same result as J2 power-law (regression).
risks: Element deletion changes the residual shape mid-solve and can break Newton. Mitigation: update the residual norm computation to use only active elements and document the behaviour in the generated file's docstring.
completion_notes: Added create_lemaitre_history() registering alpha + plastic_strain + damage_D (n_elem, n_qp) + is_deleted (n_elem,).
Extended taichi_printer with _is_plastic_material / _is_damage_material helpers and _emit_lemaitre_constitutive emitting constitutive_update_lemaitre @ti.func.
Field decls allocate damage_D (n_elem × N_QP, f64) and is_deleted (n_elem, i32); D_crit threaded as ti.f64 kernel parameter.
compute_internal_force: element-loop guard `if is_deleted[e] != 0: continue` + post-QP one-way deletion `if damage_D[e, q_chk] > D_crit: is_deleted[e] = 1`.
tangent_matvec: snapshots is_deleted via to_numpy() and skips deleted elements; uses Option A (undamaged J2 algorithmic tangent, documented).
Whitelist additions in frontend/__init__.py, ir/mechanics_ir.py, lowering/fe_localise.py thread 'lemaitre' through build_context; 'lemaitre_damage' retained as unsupported-name regression guard.
3 integration tests (emission-compiles via ast.parse + symbol presence; deletion-skip in both kernels; D=0 structural regression via J2 function substring check).
Fast suite: 1214 passed / 3 skipped / 1 pre-existing P6T5 TODO-guard (now flagging only test_lemaitre_acceptance.py for P6-3).

Forward-warning to P6-3: set S_d/s_d/eps_D/D_crit explicitly in ProblemIR params (avoid silent fallbacks in emit_main); budget Newton convergence with undamaged tangent (≤0.5% strain/step, ≥30 iterations); consider numerical D=0≡J2 probe under non-isotropic state.
